sections.label: Who I Am
sections.title: A Brief Introduction
sections.text: I'm **Ali Hamdan**, a student from Beirut with a restless curiosity spanning mathematics, electronics, and robotics education. I've competed in international robotics finals, led 70+ robotics sessions at summer camps, tutored advanced calculus, and authored three technical publications, all while maintaining a straight-A academic record. I build things with my hands, explain things with clarity, and approach every problem like an engineer and a mathematician at once.

sections.label: Behind the Scenes
sections.title: Welcome to My Lab
sections.description: **This is where it all happens.** A dedicated electronics workspace built from scratch, stocked with breadboards, soldering stations, multimeters, microcontrollers, and whatever component the next project demands. Every robot, circuit, and prototype you see across this site passed through this bench. It's part workshop, part classroom, part thinking space.
